title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Calapan Central School, Province of Mindoro, to that of Adriatico Memorial School.

text.en:
The name of Calapan Central School, Province of Mindoro, is hereby changed to that of
Adriatico Memorial School, to perpetuate the memory of the late Honorable Macario Adriatico, who has been
colonel of the Revolutionary Army, a member of the Royal Spanish Academy, a member of the Philippine
Assembly for three consecutive terms, a member of the Code Committee, and Director of the National Library
and Museum until his death.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 29, 1933.
